_comment: Local catalogue used ONLY by scripts/publish-model.js and scripts/reprice.js.
It never ships to Render and the provider never reads it — the provider learns
its rates from the chain. So adding a model here costs nothing until you publish.
upstreamUsdPerMInput / Output are what DEEPINFRA charges you. Your listing price
is this plus markupPct. VERIFY THESE against https://deepinfra.com/pricing before
publishing: a listing is a signed promise to sell at that price, and a wrong
figure means selling under cost one paid request at a time.
Only non-reasoning models belong here. Reasoning models bill their thinking as
output tokens, which makes the ceiling unpredictable for the buyer.
